title: Routes
summary: Render the active route component, fallback, or error boundary.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: fallback is optional content for cases where no route component can render. It defaults to null.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: The active module default export, HydrateFallback, ErrorBoundary, error message, or fallback.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: The component reads the router from RouterProvider. It renders one matched module, not a nested outlet tree. Completed page content stays mounted through revalidation. Components receive no automatic loaderData prop: use the data hooks.
